summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A Top OpenAI Executive, Fidji Simo, Steps Down
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Big tech must deal with scam ads under Ofcom proposals
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 63 articles published in the last 24 hours
